description:
A registration page block with two layout variants: centered card or split-panel.
Includes name, email, password with strength indicator, confirm password, and terms checkbox.

props.name: variant
props.description: Layout variant. "centered" places the form in a centered card; "split" uses a two-column layout with a branded panel.

props.name: onSubmit
props.type: (data: { name: string; email: string; password: string; confirmPassword: string; terms: boolean; }) => void
props.description: Called when the user submits the registration form.

props.name: onLogin
props.description: Called when the user clicks the login link.

props.name: logo
props.description: Logo element rendered above the form title.

props.name: description
props.defaultValue: Enter your details to get started

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.
